2608.23391.title: Cross-Domain, Multi-Task Data-to-Text Generation without In-Domain Training Data
2608.23391.paper_summary: Structured data exists in many forms (tables, knowledge graphs, charts, and time series), and converting it into text may involve different generation tasks. However, most prior work on data-to-text (D2T) generation has focused on specific tasks and datasets, relying either on task-specific training data or on the zero-shot capabilities of large language models. We study cross-domain D2T generation in a setting where neither in-domain training text nor test references are available, and where domains, generation goals, and input structures vary substantially. We compare data-driven knowledge distillation (DDKD) against zero-shot inference and fine-tuning on out-of-domain D2T data, and introduce structure-preserving augmentation via structural subsampling and perturbation. Experiments on five benchmarks show that, at constant model size (1.7B parameters), DDKD consistently outperforms both fine-tuning and zero-shot inference. Moreover, the resulting small models outperform a much larger finetuned model on two of the five domains, achieving comparable performance on the remaining three. We further construct QUINTD-5, a fivefold extension of QUINTD-1, and show that simply scaling real target-domain inputs yields only modest gains, whereas our augmentation strategy remains more effective and more cost-efficient for cross-domain distillation.
2608.23391.paper_summary_zh: 結構化數據存在多種形式（表格、知識圖譜、圖表和時間序列），將其轉換為文本可能涉及不同的生成任務。<lb/>然而，以往大多數關於數據到文本（D2T）生成的研究集中於特定任務和數據集，依賴於特定任務的訓練數據或大型語言模型的零樣本能力。<lb/>我們研究跨領域D2T生成的情況，該情況下既沒有領域內的訓練文本，也沒有測試參考，並且領域、生成目標和輸入結構有顯著變化。<lb/>我們比較了數據驅動的知識蒸餾（DDKD）與在域外D2T數據上的零樣本推理和微調，並通過結構子採樣和擾動引入了結構保留增強。<lb/>在五個基準上的實驗顯示，在模型大小不變（1.7B參數）的情況下，DDKD始終優於微調和零樣本推理。<lb/>此外，所得到的小模型在五個領域中的兩個上超越了一個更大的微調模型，並在剩下的三個領域上達到了可比的性能。<lb/>我們進一步構建了QUINTD-5，這是QUINTD-1的五倍擴展，並顯示僅僅擴大真實目標領域的輸入僅能帶來適度的增益，而我們的增強策略在跨領域蒸餾中仍然更有效且成本效益更高。
